title: Resigned as president and CEO of Kingsoft on December 20
statement: Resigned as president and CEO of Kingsoft on December 20, 2007, citing health reasons, after leading it to an IPO earlier that year.

title: Founded Xiaomi and later steered the company into new segments
statement: Founded Xiaomi and later steered the company into new segments including electric vehicles and chips.
outcome: By May 2025, Forbes estimated Lei's net worth at $42.6 billion, ranking him 33rd worldwide, per Wikipedia's citation, reflecting Xiaomi's growth including its EV pivot.

title: Retained the 'honorary chairman' title at Kingsoft Office (WPS Office
statement: Retained the 'honorary chairman' title at Kingsoft Office (WPS Office maker) as of June 2025, despite his primary focus on Xiaomi.
outcome: Kingsoft Office confirmed Lei's continued honorary-chairman role in reporting as of June 2025, indicating no full separation from the Kingsoft corporate family despite his focus on Xiaomi's smartphone/EV/chip businesses.
